stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip hotel detail pages, 18-19 Nov 2026 (Wed-Thu), 1 room 2 adults, pre-tax after discount, cheapest room per hotel, all 14 of the 16 listed 3-star Pelling hotels that showed rooms (Rufina Palm Bliss and Wisteria Crystal Manor had none). 13 of 14 were room-only or plan-unspecified (De Regency shows one room rate); The Nettle & Fern Farmstay offered only a breakfast-inclusive rate (4,554). Sorted: 1,080 / 1,166 / 1,526 / 2,100 / 2,100 / 2,155 / 2,429 / 2,509 / 3,135 / 3,500 / 3,623 / 4,076 / 4,224 / 4,554. Dorm: Hostelworld 'Dorms From' INR, undated: Mochilero Ostello 550 and Oak Valley Retreat 600.
stay.notes: 18 Nov is far below the 13-14 Nov list prices for several hotels (Sumitel 3,261 -> 2,509; Divine The Celeste 3,540 -> 1,166; Rufina Greenland 2,506 -> 1,080), so the dated pages matter. Zostel Rinchenpong (714) excluded: 9 km away in Rinchenpong. Norbulingka Retreat (listed 3-star homestay, 8,861 room only on 18 Nov) is an outlier and was not used. The Cleartrip budget list could not be priced for 18 Nov (most detail pages 404 or had no rooms; Green Leaf Resort 3,078 is 3-star), so no budget or homestay median.

point_to_point.range: 3,500 small 4-seater, 3,700 normal 8-seater, 4,000 luxury 6-seater (Sikkim Travellers 2026 chart); Gozo sedan 2,722 indicative

taxi_day.basis: Full-day Pelling sightseeing (8 hours) for a 4-seater car: sikkimtaxis.com 'Full Day Tour of Pelling (8 Hours)' 4,200 for a 4-pax car (4,800 for 8-pax Sumo, 5,500 for Innova; page undated). TAB Travels / Explore Sikkim page marked 'Applicable for year 2026' gives full-day Pelling sightseeing 4,000-5,000 in peak season (Oct to mid-Dec, which covers 18 Nov) and 3,500-4,500 off-season. The 4,200 car rate sits inside the peak range.
taxi_day.notes: Pelling runs on a local syndicate: non-Pelling cabs may drop at hotels but cannot do local sightseeing. The Pelling Tourism Development Association page mentions an official 2025 rate chart (gopelling.co.in/taxi-rates) but its numbers were not on the page. Sikkimtaxis.com is undated and quotes service tax, so its figure is treated as a floor, not a current union rate.

food_per_person_day.basis: Standard: hotel meal plans on Cleartrip, 18-19 Nov 2026, full board (breakfast, lunch, dinner) minus room only, divided by 2 adults: Rufina Greenland Premiere 1,080 -> 2,203 = 562; Retreat Crassula Ovata 2,429 -> 3,643 = 607; Jain Group Sonamchen 2,100 -> 3,938 = 919; Golden Sunrise & Spa 4,224 -> 6,930 = 1,353. Median 763, rounded to 760. Budget: Holidify West Sikkim restaurants page (undated) lists Pelling eateries at cost for two 100-250 (Gupta 100-150, Anjali 150-200, Taatopani 150-200, Lotus Bakery 150-200, Melting Point 200-250), i.e. 50-125 per person per meal; Unpaqd (20 Jan 2026) quotes local-eatery dinners at 100 and meals under 100. Budget = 3 x about 100.
food_per_person_day.notes: Standard is hotel set-meal pricing, not a cafe menu survey; no Pelling restaurant published rupee menus I could open (Tripadvisor, Zomato and Justdial pages were blocked or empty). Budget leans on an undated page and a blog, so treat as low confidence.

food_per_person_day.notes: Assembled from three hotels because none shows a clean room-only to full-board pair. Lachen has very few eateries; no dhaba or momo-stall rupee source found, so budget is null.
